purpose: Help my assistant find what I already know (conversations, email, documents and notes) and say where it came from.
steward: Me. I own this folder and everything in it.
reviewer: Me. Summaries and tags written by helpers are suggestions until I check them.

governance.admission: Only my own exports and items I chose to bring in through my connectors. Originals stay where they came from; each note links back to its source.
governance.review: Helper summaries are a convenience, not the truth. When something matters, read the note itself.
governance.correction: I can edit or delete any note. The nightly refresh rebuilds the index from what is in notes/.
governance.expression: Private to me. Nothing here is shared, uploaded or published unless I decide to share a specific note.

concepts.definition: The note is mainly about one of my projects, products, clients or businesses.
concepts.identityRule: Name the project the way I name it. Two projects with similar names are different until I say they are the same.

concepts.definition: The note records something I decided, agreed to or committed to.
concepts.identityRule: One decision per moment; a later change is a new decision, not an edit of the old one.

concepts.definition: The note holds an idea, plan, draft or option I may come back to.
concepts.identityRule: An idea is not a decision. Keep it an idea until I act on it.

concepts.definition: The note holds something I researched, learned or had explained to me.
concepts.identityRule: What a chat assistant told me is a claim to check, not a fact I observed.

concepts.definition: The note is mainly about a particular person: a conversation with them, about them, or for them.
concepts.identityRule: Matching names are not proof of the same person. Use the email address or the context.

questions.question: What will the weather be on Mars next Tuesday?
questions.work: Check that the assistant says the notes do not answer this instead of guessing.
